cardOverview.overviewText: A super-premium charge card offering unmatched lifestyle and travel benefits, including unlimited lounge access, global concierge services, and exclusive hotel and dining privileges. Additional features include milestone rewards worth ₹1,00,000 annually and access to luxury travel experiences.

benefitRows.name: Concierge
benefitRows.offer: 24×7 global concierge service for assistance regarding hotel/flight bookings.
benefitRows.howToAvail:
The American Express concierge service number is 1-800-525-3355.
You can also call the number on the back of your card and say "Concierge" when prompted.

benefitRows.name: Dining
benefitRows.offer: Up to 25% discount on dining bills at over 70+ premium restaurants across India.|Preferential reservation, complimentary drinks, and a 24×7 VIP helpline.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this benefit, log in to the dining partner’s app or website using your registered account. Explore available dining and order-in offers, select your preferred meals or restaurants, and apply the benefit at checkout to enjoy exclusive dining privileges. Complete the payment using your American Express Platinum Charge card to unlock the offer.
